column4: dialect-gated per SUBTEST (cleat#3540): the test runs one subtest per dialect that supports workflow libraries (PostgreSQL and SQL Server; MySQL has no library schema by decision D41), each through testutil.TestDB, which skips when its DSN is unset. This job configures PostgreSQL only, so the sqlserver subtest skips ONCE while postgres RUNS. Measured by name, not by delta: env -u CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL -u CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL go test ./engine/ -run TestAnInstalledLibraryDefinitionReadsThroughToItsMember -count=1 -json reports pass for /postgres_as_a_role_the_policy_applies_to, skip for /sqlserver, and nothing else.
dialect-gated per SUBTEST: the same test and the same one skipped arm; the cluster job runs ./engine/... too and configures PostgreSQL only. See the test-go/engine line above.

dialect-gated per SUBTEST: this job sets only CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL, so the postgres arm skips while sqlserver RUNS. Measured by name: env -u CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES -u CLEAT_TEST_DB -u CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL go test ./engine/ -run TestAnInstalledLibraryDefinitionReadsThroughToItsMember -count=1 -json reports skip for /postgres_as_a_role_the_policy_applies_to and pass for /sqlserver.

dialect-gated per SUBTEST: this job sets only CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL and MySQL has no library schema (D41), so BOTH arms skip here, two. That is by decision and not a gap; the test has no MySQL arm to run. Measured by name: env -u CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES -u CLEAT_TEST_DB -u CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL go test ./engine/ -run TestAnInstalledLibraryDefinitionReadsThroughToItsMember -count=1 -json reports skip for both subtests.
